provenance.method: hypothesis, not sniffed — video_format never appeared in any INCOMING_CONTROL notification across every settings capture on this camera (category/parameter/data_type/reserved mirror POCKET_6K_G2_v7.9, which has the identical never-reports-passively finding, see docs/settings.md §8). codec_quality and recording_format's category/parameter DID match the G2 exactly on this model (0x0A/0x00 and 0x01/0x09), which is the basis for trying the same coordinates here rather than a blind guess — but per design principle 6 this is unconfirmed until an active send (tools/control/send_settings_command.py --packet video_format --dimension-enum) actually changes the camera and/or shows up on another channel.

50._comment: CANDIDATE (fps_modes has no per-entry provenance field in the schema). fps_int directly observed on the wire (passive recording_format 0x01/0x09 reports, tools/captures/POCKET_6K_PRO_v8.6/POCKET_6K_PRO_v8.6_20260721T171924.json). frame_flags is genuinely resolution-dependent at this fps on real captures (0x00 for HD/UHD, 0x10 for 4K DCI — same 'windowed bit' pattern already flagged for the G2, docs/settings.md) but this table only holds one value per fps; 0 chosen as the 2-of-3-resolutions default — revisit if a recording_format write at 4K DCI needs the 0x10 variant. m_rate=0 is an untested candidate (video_format has never been sent yet) — reasonable for a round, non-NTSC rate but not confirmed.

provenance.method: passive observation from examples/record_start_stop.py real-hardware logs during induced SD card slow-write-speed testing
provenance.notes: Raw bytes FF 07 00 00 09 01 01 02 00 FE 00. Payload byte at offset 1 flips 0x01 (nominal) -> 0xFE (-2, low_margin) 0.1-1.4s before every autonomous unexpected stop observed on a known-slow SD card — 6/6 occurrences, 3 cycles x 2 camera models (POCKET_6K_G2 v7.9, POCKET_6K_PRO v8.6). Never -2 in 7 unrelated normal-session logs, where this notification fires once per session and stays 0x01. Payload offsets 0 and 2 are constant (0x00) in every sample, both conditions. NOT yet isolated from other possible autostop causes (card full, card removed, power loss) — 'slow write speed' is inference from test context, not read off the wire alone. See docs/recording.md's 'Camera-initiated stop detection' section.
